generationInputs.prompt: A woman with light brown skin, appearing to be in her late teens or early twenties with a heavier build, is seated at a table with a black tablecloth, facing forward. She has long, wavy dark brown hair that falls past her shoulders. Her facial features include a smile revealing her upper teeth. She is wearing a sleeveless, short black dress. Her hands rest on the table with five tarot cards laid out horizontally between them and a winged notebook with a pencil beside it. The background is a white brick wall with two framed images hanging on it. The image on the left depicts a crescent moon with a face and droplets falling, in the style of the Tarot de Marseille, labeled "XVIII" at the top and "LA LUNE" below the illustration. The image on the right is a framed tarot card depicting the sun with a face, rays, and sunflowers in the style of the Tarot de Marseille, labeled "XIX" at the top and "LE SOLEIL" below the illustration.
